title: Noetherian criterion for pseudo-coherence
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $K\in D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Then $K$ is pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex] if and only if there is an integer $b$ such that $H^i(K)=0$ for $i>b$ and every $H^i(K)$ is a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].
